status: Design recorded before this implementation's first result run; not an external preregistration
question: How does evaluation coverage affect workflow selection, and when is changing the evaluation program worth its cost?
budget_rule: Every arm has the same per-block label-cost allowance. Fixed search spends the amortized allowance on current workflow evaluation; revision spends part on independent procedure trials. All actual labels, candidate generation and switches are charged.
decision_rule: Select the minimum population-weighted posterior error. Ties favor standard, then specialized, then broad.
procedure_rule: At review rounds, independently trial every program and validate its selected workflow on fresh balanced labels; retain the program with greatest validation mean minus its operational evaluation cost. The outer selection rule is fixed.
reporting: All planned scenarios and sensitivities, paired seed intervals, harms, costs, program changes. No assumption of superiority over strong fixed programs.
